Table Tennis
This game was started in England in 1880s. 'International Table Tennis
Association" was established in 1926.
The first match of The Table Tennis World Championship was played
in 1927
Table Tennis was introduced in the Olympic games much later in 1988
at Seoul (S. Korea):
Table Tennis Association of India was formed in 1938
